change_log.note: Ensure expiration enforcement at DB level

stories.title: Audit Logging for Token Lifecycle Events
stories.description: Implement structured audit logging for token issuance, rotation, revocation, and validation failures, including actor, timestamp, token hash reference, and action type.

stories.title: TTL Index Enforcement and Expiry Sweep
stories.description: Configure MongoDB TTL indexes on token expiration fields and implement fallback expiry sweep logic to guarantee expired tokens are unusable even if TTL lag occurs.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; GAP: TTL enforcement not explicitly implemented in current token handling

stories.title: Backward Compatibility and Token Migration
stories.description: Introduce compatibility layer to validate legacy bearer tokens during rollout and provide migration path to new schema without service interruption.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No existing migration framework for token schema evolution
